author: BeagleSoftwareUK
description: A Sequel adapter (URL scheme beagle-turso://) that runs Sequel -- and ROM / Hanami repositories on top of it -- on a beagle-turso database: a local SQLite-compatible replica that syncs to Turso Cloud. SQL generation, schema parsing and transactions come from Sequel's shared SQLite support.

author: Tamiru
description: A Rails 8 engine providing a Stimulus 3 and Tailwind CSS 4 datepicker with accurate Ethiopian/Gregorian conversion.

author: Abdelkader Boudih
description: Orbitcast serves the ActionCable JSON protocol from a separately supervised Rust process and publishes Rails broadcasts through PostgreSQL NOTIFY. This release covers signed-stream subscriptions and broadcasting; remote connection and channel callbacks are not executed.
